technique_name: Suggest three tips for preparing for a job interview.
description:
1. Study the company and the job: Take the time to research the company and the job position. Familiarize yourself with the company’s services, products, values and mission statement. Get to know common interview questions associated with the role, and potential follow-up questions. 
2. Prepare yourself and practice: Prepare your answers to common questions, hone your communication skills and practice speaking out loud in front of a mirror or with a friend or family member. Use interactive tools
